description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity demonstrating various methods of animating multiple properties of a View in parallel, including ValueAnimator, ViewPropertyAnimator, ObjectAnimator, and PropertyValuesHolder.

classes.name: MultiPropertyAnimations
classes.description: An Android Activity showcasing different techniques for animating multiple properties of a View in parallel.

methods.name: runValueAnimator
methods.description: Animates translationX and translationY properties manually using ValueAnimator and an update listener.

methods.name: runViewPropertyAnimator
methods.description: Animates translationX and translationY properties using the View's built-in animate() method for simplicity and efficiency.

methods.name: runObjectAnimators
methods.description: Creates and starts separate ObjectAnimator instances for translationX and translationY properties.

methods.name: runObjectAnimator
methods.description: Uses PropertyValuesHolder to animate multiple properties with a single ObjectAnimator instance.
